title: Shinonome Ena — Evident Emotion & Effort〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I got an earful again today...
But I should jot down what Mr. Yukihira said while it's all still fresh in my head.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He didn't say much about my composition today, but he did point out a lot about my lack of accuracy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I guess I can feel happy about the overall composition of my drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, what's this...?
It's from Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's done working on that demo she told us about the other day? I'm guessing this means we're all gonna head over to SEKAI to listen to it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's see... We're meeting at...
<Mizuki has work, so I'd like for us to meet in three hours or so.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... There isn't much N25 stuff for me to work on at the moment, so I guess I could draw something for practice to review what we did today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright!
Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In terms of composition... Yeah, this looks like a good spot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's time until we have to meet, so I'll just try to draw what I can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this lake never has any waves. Is it because there's no wind?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I bet it'd look really pretty if there were reflections of the sky or some mountains on the surface.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
To be fair, that'd be really hard to draw.
But so is this since it isn't like a real lake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but I can't just go for something superficial...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to capture this place's atmosphere. I need to show what it feels like here...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I could've sworn that someone came over to SEKAI just now... Was I imagining things...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's not like I have anything else to do, so I guess I'll draw something...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This is coming along pretty nicely.
All that's left is...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, it's you...
You suddenly sneaking up next to me like that made me jump.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I didn't just suddenly appear...
I was drawing over there until now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you were just over there...?
Why didn't you say something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because you seemed really focused.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: More importantly, I wanna see what you were drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, but it's still a work in progress.
Here, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Those steel beam things are so hard to draw. Not only is getting the texture right a pain, but so is the depth.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't really know much about drawing, nor do I know what's hard to draw... But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This lake feels so gentle...
I kinda like it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I feel like I should be asking you that...
You're being really honest today for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you saying that I'm usually grouchier?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I didn't say that...
I was thrown a little off guard is all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's this drawing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think it made me want to speak more openly...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
For example, this line...
It looks like you drew and redrew it because you weren't happy with how it looked.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: While this curved line looked like it was gently and carefully drawn...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's clear that you put a lot of effort into this, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think that's why it made me want to say something positive...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If it made you feel that way, Rin, then I guess it really does have that effect...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, what's the time?
I'm supposed to meet Kanade and the others here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Remember that demo we all listened to the other day? No, wait... You and Miku haven't heard it yet. You two were with Mafuyu that time, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We didn't that time, but Kanade let us listen to it a little while after...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna hear what's changed, so I'll come with you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
I'm sure Kanade will want to hear as many different opinions as she can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it's just about time, so let's go look for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...
